rationale: TLR4-MD-2 is the only LPS receptor here, so blocking it leaves no signal at all. CD14 only matters at low ligand, and 100 ng/ml is a high dose, so that arm matches the reference. Interferon-gamma priming raises surface receptor, so the response is larger. Polymyxin B is used at a dose that binds only part of the LPS, so I expect the reference response.
